headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with AI driving pockets of strong performance.
summary: Coforge led the quarter with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Mid‑tier players like LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech delivered solid double‑digit growth, while Infosys saw only 1.5% revenue expansion and cut its FY27 guidance. Profit trends were uneven; HCLTech posted a 21% profit jump, but Wipro and Infosys showed modest or declining profit growth.

themes.title: AI‑enabled revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, contributing to higher margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin guidance upgrades
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin target to 16%, reflecting confidence in cost efficiencies.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue growth outlook to 1‑2% amid modest top‑line performance.
